name: Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench: MI250 x1, vLLM 0.6.1, Llama-2-7B FP16, 128in/128out, batch 64
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench, arXiv:2411.00136, All_results.csv). vLLM benchmark_throughput.py, FP16/BF16, 128 in / 128 out. Throughput = batch*(in+out)/end-to-end latency = AGGREGATE over the batch, NOT per-request decode. Batch 64, 1x MI250. Latency 3.660s.
notes: Peak point on the paper's Fig.35 sweep for Llama-2-7B; batch-64 aggregate.
